```{r fig4 基因选取}
## ============================================================
## New Figure 4: ML-refined immune modules for SCI
## 修复版：
## 1. 修复 read.csv(row.names = 1) 因重复 gene symbol 报错的问题
## 2. 用 stability LASSO 从机制候选池中筛选 refined module genes
## 3. 用 refined modules 绘制 Fig4A/B/C/D/E
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(limma)
  library(glmnet)
  library(pROC)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(patchwork)
})

set.seed(14)

## =========================
## 0. 路径设置
## =========================

outdir <- "New_Figure4_ML_refined_modules"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_gse151371 <- "GSE151371_normalized_expression_matrix_ComBat_de-ID.csv"
file_gse177034 <- "GSE177034_counts_only.csv"
file_gse226238 <- "GSE226238.csv"

## =========================
## 1. 通用函数
## =========================

read_expr_csv_safe <- function(file) {
  message("Reading file: ", file)
  
  df <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  gene_col <- df[[1]]
  df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  
  rownames(df) <- make.unique(as.character(gene_col))
  
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  
  mat <- as.matrix(df)
  return(mat)
}

clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- sub("^.*>", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  toupper(x)
}

collapse_by_gene <- function(expr) {
  expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
  expr$gene <- clean_gene_symbol(rownames(expr))
  
  expr <- expr %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene != "NA") %>%
    mutate(mean_expr = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_expr)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-mean_expr)
  
  mat <- as.matrix(expr[, setdiff(colnames(expr), "gene")])
  rownames(mat) <- expr$gene
  return(mat)
}

z_score_rows <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  return(z)
}

module_score <- function(expr_mat, genes) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))
  
  if (length(genes) < 2) {
    warning("Too few genes found for module score: ", paste(genes, collapse = ", "))
    return(rep(NA, ncol(expr_mat)))
  }
  
  z <- z_score_rows(expr_mat[genes, , drop = FALSE])
  colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
}

safe_pdf <- function(filename, width, height) {
  pdf(filename, width = width, height = height, useDingbats = FALSE)
}

## =========================
## 2. 读取 GSE151371
## =========================

expr151 <- read_expr_csv_safe(file_gse151371)
expr151 <- collapse_by_gene(expr151)

meta151 <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(expr151),
  group = case_when(
    grepl("^HC", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "HC",
    grepl("^TC", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TC",
    grepl("^SCI", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "SCI",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
)

meta151 <- meta151 %>% filter(!is.na(group))
expr151 <- expr151[, meta151$sample, drop = FALSE]
meta151$group <- factor(meta151$group, levels = c("HC", "TC", "SCI"))

message("GSE151371 expression matrix: ", nrow(expr151), " genes x ", ncol(expr151), " samples")
print(table(meta151$group))

## =========================
## 3. SCI vs HC 差异分析
## =========================

idx_hc_sci <- meta151$group %in% c("HC", "SCI")
expr_hc_sci <- expr151[, idx_hc_sci, drop = FALSE]
meta_hc_sci <- meta151[idx_hc_sci, ]

meta_hc_sci$group <- droplevels(meta_hc_sci$group)

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = meta_hc_sci)
colnames(design) <- levels(meta_hc_sci$group)

fit <- lmFit(expr_hc_sci, design)
contrast <- makeContrasts(SCI_vs_HC = SCI - HC, levels = design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

deg151 <- topTable(fit2, coef = "SCI_vs_HC", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
deg151$gene <- rownames(deg151)

write.csv(
  deg151,
  file.path(outdir, "GSE151371_DEG_SCI_vs_HC.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 4. 构建机制候选基因池
## =========================

innate_keywords <- c(
  "S100", "FCGR", "TLR", "CLEC", "NLR", "IL1", "CXCL", "CCR",
  "LILR", "CD14", "CD68", "ITG", "MMP", "MPO", "ELANE",
  "AZU", "CAMP", "CEACAM", "CSF", "IRAK", "MYD88", "NFKB",
  "ANXA", "BST", "BCL2A1", "MIR223", "SLC", "PLIN", "QPCT"
)

adaptive_keywords <- c(
  "CD3", "CD4", "CD8", "TRAC", "TRBC", "TRAV", "TRBV",
  "IL7R", "CCR7", "TCF7", "LEF1", "LCK", "ZAP70",
  "NKG7", "GNLY", "PRF1", "GZMA", "GZMB", "KLR", "FCGR3A"
)

innate_pool <- deg151 %>%
  filter(logFC > 0, adj.P.Val < 0.1) %>%
  filter(grepl(paste(innate_keywords, collapse = "|"), gene, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

adaptive_pool <- deg151 %>%
  filter(logFC < 0, adj.P.Val < 0.1) %>%
  filter(grepl(paste(adaptive_keywords, collapse = "|"), gene, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

innate_manual <- c(
  "S100A8", "S100A9", "S100A12", "ANXA3", "CLEC4D", "FCGR1A",
  "BST1", "IRAK3", "TLR5", "NLRC4", "BCL2A1", "MIR223",
  "QPCT", "SLC37A3", "SLC22A4", "PLIN3"
)

adaptive_manual <- c(
  "CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC", "TRBC1", "TRBC2", "IL7R", "CCR7",
  "TCF7", "LEF1", "ZAP70", "NKG7", "GNLY", "PRF1", "GZMA",
  "GZMB", "KLRD1", "FCGR3A"
)

innate_pool <- unique(c(innate_pool, intersect(innate_manual, rownames(expr151))))
adaptive_pool <- unique(c(adaptive_pool, intersect(adaptive_manual, rownames(expr151))))

write.csv(
  data.frame(gene = innate_pool),
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_pool_innate.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(gene = adaptive_pool),
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_pool_adaptive.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("Innate candidate genes: ", length(innate_pool))
message("Adaptive candidate genes: ", length(adaptive_pool))

## =========================
## 5. Stability LASSO 函数
## =========================
stability_lasso <- function(expr_mat,
                            meta,
                            candidate_genes,
                            positive_class = "SCI",
                            negative_class = "HC",
                            n_boot = 200,
                            alpha = 1,
                            min_freq = 0.35) {
  
  use_meta <- meta %>%
    filter(group %in% c(negative_class, positive_class))
  
  use_meta$group <- droplevels(use_meta$group)
  use_expr <- expr_mat[, use_meta$sample, drop = FALSE]
  
  genes <- intersect(candidate_genes, rownames(use_expr))
  
  if (length(genes) < 3) {
    stop("Candidate gene number is too small for LASSO: ", length(genes))
  }
  
  x_all <- t(use_expr[genes, , drop = FALSE])
  x_all <- scale(x_all)
  x_all[is.na(x_all)] <- 0
  
  y_all <- ifelse(use_meta$group == positive_class, 1, 0)
  
  idx_pos <- which(y_all == 1)
  idx_neg <- which(y_all == 0)
  
  message("Positive samples: ", length(idx_pos))
  message("Negative samples: ", length(idx_neg))
  
  if (length(idx_pos) < 2 || length(idx_neg) < 2) {
    stop("Too few samples in one class. Check group parsing.")
  }
  
  selected_list <- vector("list", n_boot)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    
    ## 分层 bootstrap：SCI 和 HC 分别抽样
    boot_pos <- sample(idx_pos, size = length(idx_pos), replace = TRUE)
    boot_neg <- sample(idx_neg, size = length(idx_neg), replace = TRUE)
    boot_idx <- c(boot_pos, boot_neg)
    
    x <- x_all[boot_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    y <- y_all[boot_idx]
    
    ## nfolds 不能超过最小类别样本数
    nfold_use <- min(5, table(y))
    nfold_use <- max(3, as.integer(nfold_use))
    
    cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      family = "binomial",
      alpha = alpha,
      nfolds = nfold_use,
      type.measure = "deviance"
    )
    
    coef_i <- coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.1se")
    sel <- rownames(coef_i)[as.vector(coef_i != 0)]
    sel <- setdiff(sel, "(Intercept)")
    
    selected_list[[i]] <- sel
  }
  
  freq <- table(unlist(selected_list))
  
  ## 如果 lambda.1se 过于严格，改用 lambda.min
  if (length(freq) == 0) {
    
    warning("No genes selected with lambda.1se. Trying lambda.min instead.")
    
    selected_list <- vector("list", n_boot)
    
    for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
      
      boot_pos <- sample(idx_pos, size = length(idx_pos), replace = TRUE)
      boot_neg <- sample(idx_neg, size = length(idx_neg), replace = TRUE)
      boot_idx <- c(boot_pos, boot_neg)
      
      x <- x_all[boot_idx, , drop = FALSE]
      y <- y_all[boot_idx]
      
      nfold_use <- min(5, table(y))
      nfold_use <- max(3, as.integer(nfold_use))
      
      cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        family = "binomial",
        alpha = alpha,
        nfolds = nfold_use,
        type.measure = "deviance"
      )
      
      coef_i <- coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.min")
      sel <- rownames(coef_i)[as.vector(coef_i != 0)]
      sel <- setdiff(sel, "(Intercept)")
      
      selected_list[[i]] <- sel
    }
    
    freq <- table(unlist(selected_list))
  }
  
  freq_df <- data.frame(
    gene = names(freq),
    selection_frequency = as.numeric(freq) / n_boot
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(selection_frequency))
  
  refined <- freq_df %>%
    filter(selection_frequency >= min_freq) %>%
    pull(gene)
  
  if (length(refined) < 2) {
    warning("Too few genes passed min_freq. Using top selected genes instead.")
    refined <- freq_df %>%
      slice_head(n = min(8, nrow(freq_df))) %>%
      pull(gene)
  }
  
  list(
    frequency = freq_df,
    refined_genes = refined
  )
}

## =========================
## 6. ML-refined module gene selection
## =========================

lasso_innate <- stability_lasso(
  expr_mat = expr151,
  meta = meta151,
  candidate_genes = innate_pool,
  n_boot = 200,
  min_freq = 0.35
)

lasso_adaptive <- stability_lasso(
  expr_mat = expr151,
  meta = meta151,
  candidate_genes = adaptive_pool,
  n_boot = 200,
  min_freq = 0.35
)

refined_innate <- lasso_innate$refined_genes
refined_adaptive <- lasso_adaptive$refined_genes

write.csv(
  lasso_innate$frequency,
  file.path(outdir, "ML_selection_frequency_innate.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  lasso_adaptive$frequency,
  file.path(outdir, "ML_selection_frequency_adaptive.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

writeLines(refined_innate, file.path(outdir, "Refined_innate_module_genes.txt"))
writeLines(refined_adaptive, file.path(outdir, "Refined_adaptive_module_genes.txt"))

message("Refined innate genes: ", paste(refined_innate, collapse = ", "))
message("Refined adaptive genes: ", paste(refined_adaptive, collapse = ", "))

## =========================
## 7. Fig4A: selection frequency barplot
## =========================

plot_selection_frequency <- function(freq_df, title) {
  freq_df %>%
    slice_max(selection_frequency, n = 20) %>%
    mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = rev(gene))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = gene, y = selection_frequency)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Selection frequency", title = title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8)
    )
}

p4A1 <- plot_selection_frequency(
  lasso_innate$frequency,
  "ML-refined innate module"
)

p4A2 <- plot_selection_frequency(
  lasso_adaptive$frequency,
  "ML-refined adaptive module"
)

p4A <- p4A1 / p4A2

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig4A_ML_selection_frequency.pdf"),
  p4A,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  units = "cm"
)

## =========================
## 8. Fig4B: GSE177034 refined module heatmap
## =========================

if (file.exists(file_gse177034)) {
  
  expr177 <- read_expr_csv_safe(file_gse177034)
  expr177 <- collapse_by_gene(expr177)
  
  meta177 <- data.frame(
    sample = colnames(expr177),
    time = case_when(
      grepl("t0|baseline|pre", colnames(expr177), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "t0",
      grepl("t1|post|follow", colnames(expr177), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "t1",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
  
  meta177 <- meta177 %>% filter(!is.na(time))
  
  if (nrow(meta177) >= 2) {
    
    expr177 <- expr177[, meta177$sample, drop = FALSE]
    meta177$time <- factor(meta177$time, levels = c("t0", "t1"))
    
    heat_genes <- unique(c(refined_innate, refined_adaptive))
    heat_genes <- intersect(heat_genes, rownames(expr177))
    
    if (length(heat_genes) >= 2) {
      
      mat_heat <- expr177[heat_genes, , drop = FALSE]
      mat_heat_z <- z_score_rows(log2(mat_heat + 1))
      
      gene_class <- data.frame(
        Module = ifelse(
          rownames(mat_heat_z) %in% refined_innate,
          "Refined innate",
          "Refined adaptive"
        )
      )
      rownames(gene_class) <- rownames(mat_heat_z)
      
      ann_col <- data.frame(Time = meta177$time)
      rownames(ann_col) <- meta177$sample
      
      safe_pdf(
        file.path(outdir, "Fig4B_GSE177034_refined_module_heatmap.pdf"),
        width = 7,
        height = 6
      )
      
      pheatmap(
        mat_heat_z,
        annotation_col = ann_col,
        annotation_row = gene_class,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_cols = TRUE,
        fontsize = 8,
        fontsize_row = 7,
        fontsize_col = 7,
        border_color = NA,
        main = "ML-refined immune modules in GSE177034"
      )
      
      dev.off()
      
      write.csv(
        mat_heat_z,
        file.path(outdir, "Fig4B_heatmap_matrix_GSE177034.csv")
      )
    }
  }
}

## =========================
## 9. 读取 GSE226238 并计算 trajectory score
## =========================

expr226_raw <- read_expr_csv_safe(file_gse226238)

## 如果列名看起来像基因名，说明当前是 samples x genes，需要转置
if (mean(grepl(">|^NM_|^ENSG|^[A-Z0-9-]+$", colnames(expr226_raw))) > 0.5) {
  message("GSE226238 appears to be samples x genes. Transposing to genes x samples.")
  expr226_raw <- t(expr226_raw)
}

expr226 <- collapse_by_gene(expr226_raw)

meta226 <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(expr226),
  group = case_when(
    grepl("control|ctrl|healthy|uninj", colnames(expr226), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",
    TRUE ~ "SCI"
  ),
  time = case_when(
    grepl("control|ctrl|healthy|uninj", colnames(expr226), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",
    grepl("0.?3d|0_3d|d0|day0|acute|v0", colnames(expr226), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "0-3d",
    grepl("3m|m3|3mpi|v3", colnames(expr226), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "3m",
    grepl("6m|m6|6mpi|v6", colnames(expr226), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "6m",
    grepl("12m|m12|1y|1yr|v12", colnames(expr226), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "12m",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  subject = str_extract(
    colnames(expr226),
    "ID\\d+|P\\d{2,4}|PT\\d{2,4}|subj\\d{2,4}|patient\\d{2,4}|\\d{2,4}"
  )
)

meta226 <- meta226 %>% filter(!is.na(time))
expr226 <- expr226[, meta226$sample, drop = FALSE]
meta226$time <- factor(meta226$time, levels = c("Control", "0-3d", "3m", "6m", "12m"))

message("GSE226238 samples by time:")
print(table(meta226$time))

score226 <- meta226 %>%
  mutate(
    refined_innate_score = module_score(expr226, refined_innate),
    refined_adaptive_score = module_score(expr226, refined_adaptive),
    immune_reprogramming_score = refined_innate_score - refined_adaptive_score
  )

write.csv(
  score226,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig4CDE_GSE226238_refined_module_scores.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 10. Fig4C/D: trajectory plots
## =========================

plot_trajectory <- function(df, score_col, ylab, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = .data[[score_col]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(
        c("0-3d", "3m"),
        c("0-3d", "6m"),
        c("0-3d", "12m")
      ),
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      size = 3
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8)
    )
}

p4C <- plot_trajectory(
  score226,
  "refined_innate_score",
  "Refined innate module score",
  "Acute innate activation"
)

p4D <- plot_trajectory(
  score226,
  "refined_adaptive_score",
  "Refined adaptive module score",
  "Adaptive immune suppression"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig4C_Refined_innate_trajectory.pdf"),
  p4C,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  units = "cm"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig4D_Refined_adaptive_trajectory.pdf"),
  p4D,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  units = "cm"
)

## =========================
## 11. Fig4E: acute innate vs chronic adaptive correlation
## =========================

paired_df <- score226 %>%
  filter(!is.na(subject), time %in% c("0-3d", "12m")) %>%
  select(subject, time, refined_innate_score, refined_adaptive_score) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = time,
    values_from = c(refined_innate_score, refined_adaptive_score)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`refined_innate_score_0-3d`),
    !is.na(`refined_adaptive_score_12m`)
  )

if (nrow(paired_df) >= 3) {
  
  cor_test <- cor.test(
    paired_df$`refined_innate_score_0-3d`,
    paired_df$`refined_adaptive_score_12m`,
    method = "spearman"
  )
  
  p4E <- ggplot(
    paired_df,
    aes(
      x = `refined_innate_score_0-3d`,
      y = `refined_adaptive_score_12m`
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.6) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    labs(
      x = "Acute refined innate score",
      y = "Chronic refined adaptive score",
      title = paste0(
        "Acute innate vs chronic adaptive\n",
        "Spearman rho = ",
        round(cor_test$estimate, 2),
        ", P = ",
        signif(cor_test$p.value, 2)
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(outdir, "Fig4E_Acute_innate_to_chronic_adaptive_correlation.pdf"),
    p4E,
    width = 8,
    height = 7,
    units = "cm"
  )
  
  write.csv(
    paired_df,
    file.path(outdir, "Fig4E_paired_subject_scores.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  write.csv(
    data.frame(
      spearman_rho = as.numeric(cor_test$estimate),
      p_value = cor_test$p.value,
      n_subjects = nrow(paired_df)
    ),
    file.path(outdir, "Fig4E_correlation_stats.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

## =========================
## 12. Combined CDE figure
## =========================

if (exists("p4E")) {
  p4CDE <- p4C + p4D + p4E + plot_layout(ncol = 3)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(outdir, "Fig4CDE_combined_refined_modules.pdf"),
    p4CDE,
    width = 18,
    height = 7,
    units = "cm"
  )
}

## =========================
## 13. 输出 summary
## =========================

summary_table <- data.frame(
  module = c("Refined innate", "Refined adaptive"),
  n_genes = c(length(refined_innate), length(refined_adaptive)),
  genes = c(
    paste(refined_innate, collapse = "; "),
    paste(refined_adaptive, collapse = "; ")
  )
)

write.csv(
  summary_table,
  file.path(outdir, "New_Figure4_refined_module_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("All outputs saved to: ", outdir)
```

```{r fig4 重新绘图}
## ============================================================
## Figure 4B/C/D/E plotting only
## 不重新跑 LASSO，不拼图
##
## Inputs:
## New_Figure4_ML_refined_modules/
## ├── New_Figure4_refined_module_summary.csv
## ├── Fig4B_heatmap_matrix_GSE177034.csv
## └── Fig4CDE_GSE226238_refined_module_scores.csv
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(RColorBrewer)
})

## =========================
## 0. 路径
## =========================

indir  <- "New_Figure4_ML_refined_modules"
outdir <- file.path(indir, "Publication_ready_Fig4_redraw_BCDE")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

## =========================
## 1. 配色与主题
## =========================

col_innate   <- "#D73027"
col_adaptive <- "#4575B4"
col_index    <- "#7B3294"

time_cols <- c(
  "0-3d" = "#D73027",
  "3m"   = "#FDAE61",
  "6m"   = "#ABD9E9",
  "12m"  = "#4575B4",
  "t0"   = "#D73027",
  "t1"   = "#4575B4"
)

module_cols <- c(
  "Refined innate"   = col_innate,
  "Refined adaptive" = col_adaptive
)

theme_pub <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

## =========================
## 2. 读取 refined genes
## =========================

summary_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(indir, "New_Figure4_refined_module_summary.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

refined_innate <- summary_df %>%
  filter(module == "Refined innate") %>%
  pull(genes) %>%
  strsplit(";\\s*") %>%
  unlist()

refined_adaptive <- summary_df %>%
  filter(module == "Refined adaptive") %>%
  pull(genes) %>%
  strsplit(";\\s*") %>%
  unlist()

refined_innate <- refined_innate[refined_innate != ""]
refined_adaptive <- refined_adaptive[refined_adaptive != ""]

## ============================================================
## Fig4B: Heatmap
## ============================================================

mat_heat <- read.csv(
  file.path(indir, "Fig4B_heatmap_matrix_GSE177034.csv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

mat_heat <- as.matrix(mat_heat)

## 限制极端值，增强可读性
mat_heat[mat_heat > 3]  <- 3
mat_heat[mat_heat < -3] <- -3

gene_module <- data.frame(
  Module = ifelse(
    rownames(mat_heat) %in% refined_innate,
    "Refined innate",
    "Refined adaptive"
  )
)
rownames(gene_module) <- rownames(mat_heat)

sample_time <- case_when(
  grepl("t0|baseline|pre", colnames(mat_heat), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "t0",
  grepl("t1|post|follow", colnames(mat_heat), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "t1",
  TRUE ~ "Unknown"
)

ann_col <- data.frame(Time = sample_time)
rownames(ann_col) <- colnames(mat_heat)

## 按时间排序，但不丢失任何样本
ord_col <- order(factor(ann_col$Time, levels = c("t0", "t1", "Unknown")))
mat_heat <- mat_heat[, ord_col, drop = FALSE]
ann_col <- ann_col[ord_col, , drop = FALSE]

## 行按 module 排列，module 内部允许聚类会更自然
ord_row <- order(factor(gene_module$Module, levels = c("Refined innate", "Refined adaptive")))
mat_heat <- mat_heat[ord_row, , drop = FALSE]
gene_module <- gene_module[ord_row, , drop = FALSE]

ann_colors <- list(
  Time = time_cols,
  Module = module_cols
)

col_heat <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#2166AC",   # softer blue
  "#67A9CF",
  "#D1E5F0",
  "#F7F7F7",
  "#FDDBC7",
  "#EF8A62",
  "#B2182B"    # softer red
))(100)

breaks_use <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)

## 关键：自动根据样本数调整宽度
## 这样不会丢数据，但每个 cell 会比之前更宽
n_sample <- ncol(mat_heat)
n_gene   <- nrow(mat_heat)

heat_width_cm  <- max(16, min(34, n_sample * 0.18 + 6))
heat_height_cm <- max(6.5, n_gene * 0.55 + 2.5)

pdf(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig4B_refined_module_heatmap_redraw.pdf"),
  width = heat_width_cm / 2.54,
  height = heat_height_cm / 2.54,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

pheatmap(
  mat_heat,
  color = col_heat,
  breaks = breaks_use,
  annotation_col = ann_col,
  annotation_row = gene_module,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize = 8,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  annotation_names_col = FALSE,
  annotation_names_row = FALSE,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "ML-refined immune programs in GSE177034"
)

dev.off()

## ============================================================
## Fig4C/D/E: trajectories
## ============================================================

scores <- read.csv(
  file.path(indir, "Fig4CDE_GSE226238_refined_module_scores.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

scores$time <- factor(scores$time, levels = c("0-3d", "3m", "6m", "12m"))

scores <- scores %>%
  mutate(
    immune_reprogramming_index =
      refined_innate_score - refined_adaptive_score
  )

plot_traj <- function(df, score_col, ylab, title) {
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = .data[[score_col]])) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(fill = time),
      width = 0.52,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.09,
      size = 0.85,
      alpha = 0.75,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(
        c("0-3d", "3m"),
        c("0-3d", "6m"),
        c("0-3d", "12m")
      ),
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      size = 2.8,
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = time_cols) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme_pub(8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
    )
}

pC <- plot_traj(
  scores,
  "refined_innate_score",
  "Refined innate module score",
  "Transient acute innate activation"
)

pD <- plot_traj(
  scores,
  "refined_adaptive_score",
  "Refined adaptive module score",
  "Acute adaptive suppression and recovery"
)

pE <- plot_traj(
  scores,
  "immune_reprogramming_index",
  "Innate − adaptive score",
  "Immune reprogramming index"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig4C_innate_trajectory_redraw.pdf"),
  pC,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "cm",
  device = "pdf"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig4D_adaptive_trajectory_redraw.pdf"),
  pD,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "cm",
  device = "pdf"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig4E_reprogramming_index_redraw.pdf"),
  pE,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "cm",
  device = "pdf"
)

message("Redrawn Fig4B/C/D/E saved to: ", outdir)
```

```{r fig5 5.19}
## ============================================================
## New Figure 5: Low-complexity classifier based on ML-refined immune modules
##
## 思路：
## Fig4 已经得到 refined innate / adaptive genes
## Fig5 不再做多模型竞赛，而是：
## 1. 计算 refined innate score / refined adaptive score
## 2. 用两个 module score 建 logistic classifier
## 3. 输出 ROC
## 4. bootstrap AUC confidence interval
## 5. permutation test
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(glmnet)
  library(pROC)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(patchwork)
})

set.seed(123)

## =========================
## 0. 路径
## =========================

outdir <- "New_Figure5_low_complexity_classifier"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_expr151 <- "GSE151371_normalized_expression_matrix_ComBat_de-ID.csv"

fig4_dir <- "New_Figure4_ML_refined_modules"
file_module_summary <- file.path(fig4_dir, "New_Figure4_refined_module_summary.csv")

## =========================
## 1. 通用函数
## =========================

read_expr_csv_safe <- function(file) {
  df <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  gene_col <- df[[1]]
  df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  
  rownames(df) <- make.unique(as.character(gene_col))
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  
  as.matrix(df)
}

clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- sub("^.*>", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  toupper(x)
}

collapse_by_gene <- function(expr) {
  expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
  expr$gene <- clean_gene_symbol(rownames(expr))
  
  expr <- expr %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene != "NA") %>%
    mutate(mean_expr = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_expr)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-mean_expr)
  
  mat <- as.matrix(expr[, setdiff(colnames(expr), "gene")])
  rownames(mat) <- expr$gene
  mat
}

z_score_rows <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z
}

module_score <- function(expr_mat, genes) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))
  
  if (length(genes) < 2) {
    stop("Too few genes found for module score: ", paste(genes, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  z <- z_score_rows(expr_mat[genes, , drop = FALSE])
  colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
}

theme_pub <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

## =========================
## 2. 读取 refined module genes
## =========================

module_summary <- read.csv(
  file_module_summary,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

refined_innate <- module_summary %>%
  filter(module == "Refined innate") %>%
  pull(genes) %>%
  strsplit(";\\s*") %>%
  unlist()

refined_adaptive <- module_summary %>%
  filter(module == "Refined adaptive") %>%
  pull(genes) %>%
  strsplit(";\\s*") %>%
  unlist()

refined_innate <- refined_innate[refined_innate != ""]
refined_adaptive <- refined_adaptive[refined_adaptive != ""]

message("Refined innate genes: ", paste(refined_innate, collapse = ", "))
message("Refined adaptive genes: ", paste(refined_adaptive, collapse = ", "))

## =========================
## 3. 读取 GSE151371
## =========================

expr151 <- read_expr_csv_safe(file_expr151)
expr151 <- collapse_by_gene(expr151)

meta151 <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(expr151),
  group = case_when(
    grepl("^HC", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "HC",
    grepl("^TC", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TC",
    grepl("^SCI", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "SCI",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
)

meta151 <- meta151 %>% filter(!is.na(group))
expr151 <- expr151[, meta151$sample, drop = FALSE]
meta151$group <- factor(meta151$group, levels = c("HC", "TC", "SCI"))

print(table(meta151$group))

## =========================
## 4. 计算 module scores
## =========================

score_df <- meta151 %>%
  mutate(
    refined_innate_score = module_score(expr151, refined_innate),
    refined_adaptive_score = module_score(expr151, refined_adaptive),
    immune_reprogramming_index = refined_innate_score - refined_adaptive_score
  )

write.csv(
  score_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_module_scores_GSE151371.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 5. 只用 HC vs SCI 建低复杂度 classifier
## =========================

clf_df <- score_df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("HC", "SCI")) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = ifelse(group == "SCI", 1, 0),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("HC", "SCI"))
  )

x <- clf_df %>%
  select(refined_innate_score, refined_adaptive_score) %>%
  as.matrix()

y <- clf_df$outcome

## =========================
## 6. Logistic regression classifier
## =========================

fit_logit <- glm(
  outcome ~ refined_innate_score + refined_adaptive_score,
  data = clf_df,
  family = binomial()
)

clf_df$pred_prob <- predict(fit_logit, type = "response")

roc_obj <- roc(
  response = clf_df$group,
  predictor = clf_df$pred_prob,
  levels = c("HC", "SCI"),
  direction = "<"
)

auc_real <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    AUC = auc_real,
    model = "Two-module logistic classifier"
  ),
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_main_classifier_auc.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  clf_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_classifier_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 7. Fig5A: classifier schematic
## =========================

schematic_df <- data.frame(
  x = c(1, 1, 2.2, 3.4),
  y = c(1.7, 0.7, 1.2, 1.2),
  label = c(
    "Refined innate\nmodule score",
    "Refined adaptive\nmodule score",
    "Low-complexity\nlogistic model",
    "SCI probability"
  )
)

pA <- ggplot() +
  geom_label(
    data = schematic_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    size = 2.8,
    label.size = 0.25,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1.35, y = 1.7, xend = 1.85, yend = 1.3),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1.35, y = 0.7, xend = 1.85, yend = 1.1),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 2.55, y = 1.2, xend = 3.05, yend = 1.2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  xlim(0.5, 3.9) +
  ylim(0.25, 2.15) +
  labs(title = "Two-module immune classifier") +
  theme_void(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5A_classifier_schematic.pdf"),
  pA,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 8. Fig5B: ROC curve
## =========================

roc_df <- data.frame(
  specificity = roc_obj$specificities,
  sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities
) %>%
  mutate(
    FPR = 1 - specificity,
    TPR = sensitivity
  )

pB <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "#7B3294") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "ROC of low-complexity classifier",
    subtitle = paste0("AUC = ", round(auc_real, 3)),
    x = "False positive rate",
    y = "True positive rate"
  ) +
  theme_pub(8)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5B_ROC_low_complexity_classifier.pdf"),
  pB,
  width = 7,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 9. Bootstrap AUC confidence interval
## =========================

n_boot <- 1000
boot_auc <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)

for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
  
  idx_hc  <- which(clf_df$group == "HC")
  idx_sci <- which(clf_df$group == "SCI")
  
  boot_idx <- c(
    sample(idx_hc, length(idx_hc), replace = TRUE),
    sample(idx_sci, length(idx_sci), replace = TRUE)
  )
  
  boot_df <- clf_df[boot_idx, ]
  
  fit_i <- tryCatch(
    glm(
      outcome ~ refined_innate_score + refined_adaptive_score,
      data = boot_df,
      family = binomial()
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_i)) next
  
  boot_df$pred_prob <- predict(fit_i, type = "response")
  
  roc_i <- tryCatch(
    roc(
      response = boot_df$group,
      predictor = boot_df$pred_prob,
      levels = c("HC", "SCI"),
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (!is.null(roc_i)) {
    boot_auc[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_i))
  }
}

boot_auc <- boot_auc[!is.na(boot_auc)]

ci_auc <- quantile(boot_auc, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

boot_auc_df <- data.frame(AUC = boot_auc)

write.csv(
  boot_auc_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5C_bootstrap_auc_distribution.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    AUC_real = auc_real,
    AUC_boot_median = ci_auc[2],
    AUC_boot_CI_low = ci_auc[1],
    AUC_boot_CI_high = ci_auc[3],
    n_boot_valid = length(boot_auc)
  ),
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5C_bootstrap_auc_CI.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

pC <- ggplot(boot_auc_df, aes(x = AUC)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "#7B3294",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = auc_real,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = ci_auc[c(1, 3)],
    color = "grey30",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap validation of classifier AUC",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Median AUC = ", round(ci_auc[2], 3),
      "; 95% CI = ",
      round(ci_auc[1], 3), "–", round(ci_auc[3], 3)
    ),
    x = "Bootstrap AUC",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_pub(8)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5C_bootstrap_AUC_CI.pdf"),
  pC,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 10. Permutation test
## =========================

n_perm <- 1000
perm_auc <- rep(NA_real_, n_perm)

for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
  
  perm_df <- clf_df
  perm_df$outcome_perm <- sample(perm_df$outcome)
  perm_df$group_perm <- factor(
    ifelse(perm_df$outcome_perm == 1, "SCI", "HC"),
    levels = c("HC", "SCI")
  )
  
  fit_perm <- tryCatch(
    glm(
      outcome_perm ~ refined_innate_score + refined_adaptive_score,
      data = perm_df,
      family = binomial()
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_perm)) next
  
  perm_df$pred_prob_perm <- predict(fit_perm, type = "response")
  
  roc_perm <- tryCatch(
    roc(
      response = perm_df$group_perm,
      predictor = perm_df$pred_prob_perm,
      levels = c("HC", "SCI"),
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (!is.null(roc_perm)) {
    perm_auc[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_perm))
  }
}

perm_auc <- perm_auc[!is.na(perm_auc)]

perm_p <- (sum(perm_auc >= auc_real) + 1) / (length(perm_auc) + 1)

perm_df_out <- data.frame(AUC = perm_auc)

write.csv(
  perm_df_out,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5D_permutation_auc_distribution.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    AUC_real = auc_real,
    permutation_p_value = perm_p,
    n_perm_valid = length(perm_auc)
  ),
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5D_permutation_test_stats.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

pD <- ggplot(perm_df_out, aes(x = AUC)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = auc_real,
    color = "#D73027",
    linewidth = 0.75
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Permutation test against random labels",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Observed AUC = ", round(auc_real, 3),
      "; permutation P = ", signif(perm_p, 3)
    ),
    x = "Permutation AUC",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_pub(8)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5D_permutation_test.pdf"),
  pD,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 11. Optional: module score distribution by group
## =========================
## 这张图可以作为补充或替代 Fig5A

score_long <- score_df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("HC", "SCI")) %>%
  select(sample, group, refined_innate_score, refined_adaptive_score, immune_reprogramming_index) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(refined_innate_score, refined_adaptive_score, immune_reprogramming_index),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    score_type = recode(
      score_type,
      refined_innate_score = "Refined innate",
      refined_adaptive_score = "Refined adaptive",
      immune_reprogramming_index = "Innate − adaptive"
    )
  )

p_score <- ggplot(score_long, aes(x = group, y = score, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.55,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.10,
    size = 1.0,
    alpha = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ score_type, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HC" = "#4D4D4D", "SCI" = "#D73027")) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Refined immune program scores distinguish SCI",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Module score"
  ) +
  theme_pub(8) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_optional_module_score_distribution.pdf"),
  p_score,
  width = 13,
  height = 5.5,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 12. Combined ABCD
## =========================

pABCD <- pA + pB + pC + pD +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, widths = c(1.05, 1, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5ABCD_combined_low_complexity_classifier.pdf"),
  pABCD,
  width = 18,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 13. 输出 summary
## =========================

summary_out <- data.frame(
  model = "Two-module logistic classifier",
  features = "refined_innate_score + refined_adaptive_score",
  AUC_observed = auc_real,
  bootstrap_AUC_median = as.numeric(ci_auc[2]),
  bootstrap_AUC_CI_low = as.numeric(ci_auc[1]),
  bootstrap_AUC_CI_high = as.numeric(ci_auc[3]),
  permutation_p_value = perm_p,
  n_HC = sum(clf_df$group == "HC"),
  n_SCI = sum(clf_df$group == "SCI")
)

write.csv(
  summary_out,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_low_complexity_classifier_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("All New Fig5 outputs saved to: ", outdir)
```

```{r fig5 5.20}
## ============================================================
## Final Figure 5 - enlarged version
## Mechanism-constrained low-complexity classifier
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(pROC)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(patchwork)
})

set.seed(123)

## =========================
## 0. Paths
## =========================

outdir <- "Final_Figure5_mechanism_constrained_classifier_large"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_expr151 <- "GSE151371_normalized_expression_matrix_ComBat_de-ID.csv"

fig4_dir <- "New_Figure4_ML_refined_modules"
file_module_summary <- file.path(
  fig4_dir,
  "New_Figure4_refined_module_summary.csv"
)

## =========================
## 1. Helper functions
## =========================

read_expr_csv_safe <- function(file) {
  df <- read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  gene_col <- df[[1]]
  df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]

  rownames(df) <- make.unique(as.character(gene_col))
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

  as.matrix(df)
}

clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- sub("^.*>", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  toupper(x)
}

collapse_by_gene <- function(expr) {
  expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
  expr$gene <- clean_gene_symbol(rownames(expr))

  expr <- expr %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene != "NA") %>%
    mutate(mean_expr = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_expr)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-mean_expr)

  mat <- as.matrix(expr[, setdiff(colnames(expr), "gene")])
  rownames(mat) <- expr$gene
  mat
}

z_score_rows <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z
}

module_score <- function(expr_mat, genes, module_name = "module") {
  genes <- clean_gene_symbol(genes)
  genes_found <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))

  message(
    module_name,
    ": ",
    length(genes_found),
    "/",
    length(unique(genes)),
    " genes found: ",
    paste(genes_found, collapse = ", ")
  )

  if (length(genes_found) < 2) {
    stop("Too few genes found for ", module_name)
  }

  z <- z_score_rows(expr_mat[genes_found, , drop = FALSE])
  colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
}

theme_pub <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.45, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.45, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

## =========================
## 2. Read refined module genes
## =========================

module_summary <- read.csv(file_module_summary, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

refined_innate <- module_summary %>%
  filter(module == "Refined innate") %>%
  pull(genes) %>%
  strsplit(";\\s*") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  clean_gene_symbol()

refined_adaptive <- module_summary %>%
  filter(module == "Refined adaptive") %>%
  pull(genes) %>%
  strsplit(";\\s*") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  clean_gene_symbol()

refined_innate <- refined_innate[refined_innate != ""]
refined_adaptive <- refined_adaptive[refined_adaptive != ""]

message("Refined innate genes: ", paste(refined_innate, collapse = ", "))
message("Refined adaptive genes: ", paste(refined_adaptive, collapse = ", "))

## =========================
## 3. Read GSE151371
## =========================

expr151 <- read_expr_csv_safe(file_expr151)
expr151 <- collapse_by_gene(expr151)

meta151 <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(expr151),
  group = case_when(
    grepl("^HC", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "HC",
    grepl("^TC", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TC",
    grepl("^SCI", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "SCI",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

meta151 <- meta151 %>% filter(!is.na(group))
expr151 <- expr151[, meta151$sample, drop = FALSE]

meta151$group <- factor(meta151$group, levels = c("HC", "TC", "SCI"))

message("Sample size:")
print(table(meta151$group))

## =========================
## 4. Module scores
## =========================

score_df <- meta151 %>%
  mutate(
    refined_innate_score = module_score(
      expr151,
      refined_innate,
      "Refined innate"
    ),
    refined_adaptive_score = module_score(
      expr151,
      refined_adaptive,
      "Refined adaptive"
    ),
    immune_reprogramming_index =
      refined_innate_score - refined_adaptive_score
  )

write.csv(
  score_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_module_scores_GSE151371.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 5. HC vs SCI classifier data
## =========================

clf_df <- score_df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("HC", "SCI")) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("HC", "SCI")),
    outcome = ifelse(group == "SCI", 1, 0)
  )

message("Classifier sample size:")
print(table(clf_df$group))

## =========================
## 6. Logistic classifier
## =========================

fit_logit <- glm(
  outcome ~ refined_innate_score + refined_adaptive_score,
  data = clf_df,
  family = binomial()
)

clf_df$pred_prob <- predict(fit_logit, type = "response")

roc_obj <- roc(
  response = clf_df$group,
  predictor = clf_df$pred_prob,
  levels = c("HC", "SCI"),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

auc_real <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))

write.csv(
  clf_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_classifier_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 7. Fig5A: enlarged schematic
## =========================

schematic_df <- data.frame(
  x = c(1, 1, 2.45, 3.9),
  y = c(1.8, 0.8, 1.3, 1.3),
  label = c(
    "Refined innate\nprogram score",
    "Refined adaptive\nprogram score",
    "Two-feature\nlogistic classifier",
    "Within-cohort\nSCI probability"
  )
)

pA <- ggplot() +
  geom_label(
    data = schematic_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    size = 4.2,
    label.size = 0.35,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1.45, y = 1.8, xend = 1.95, yend = 1.4),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.22, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1.45, y = 0.8, xend = 1.95, yend = 1.2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.22, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 2.95, y = 1.3, xend = 3.4, yend = 1.3),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.22, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2.45,
    y = 0.42,
    label = "Mechanism-constrained, low-complexity model",
    size = 4
  ) +
  xlim(0.35, 4.45) +
  ylim(0.2, 2.25) +
  labs(title = "Mechanism-constrained classifier") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5A_classifier_design_large.pdf"),
  pA,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 8. Fig5B: enlarged two-module score space
## =========================

pB <- ggplot(
  clf_df,
  aes(
    x = refined_innate_score,
    y = refined_adaptive_score,
    color = group,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  stat_ellipse(
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.55,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3.2,
    alpha = 0.9,
    stroke = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("HC" = "#4D4D4D", "SCI" = "#D73027")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("HC" = "#4D4D4D", "SCI" = "#D73027")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Two-dimensional immune-program space",
    subtitle = "SCI shifts toward innate-high / adaptive-low state",
    x = "Refined innate module score",
    y = "Refined adaptive module score",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub(11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5B_two_module_score_space_large.pdf"),
  pB,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 9. Fig5C: enlarged ROC
## =========================

roc_df <- data.frame(
  specificity = roc_obj$specificities,
  sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities
) %>%
  mutate(
    FPR = 1 - specificity,
    TPR = sensitivity
  )

pC <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "grey55"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.0,
    color = "#7B3294"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Internal classifier performance",
    subtitle = paste0("Within-cohort AUC = ", round(auc_real, 3)),
    x = "False positive rate",
    y = "True positive rate"
  ) +
  theme_pub(11)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5C_ROC_internal_performance_large.pdf"),
  pC,
  width = 10,
  height = 9,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 10. Bootstrap AUC CI
## =========================

n_boot <- 1000
boot_auc <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)

idx_hc <- which(clf_df$group == "HC")
idx_sci <- which(clf_df$group == "SCI")

for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {

  boot_idx <- c(
    sample(idx_hc, length(idx_hc), replace = TRUE),
    sample(idx_sci, length(idx_sci), replace = TRUE)
  )

  boot_df <- clf_df[boot_idx, ]

  fit_i <- tryCatch(
    glm(
      outcome ~ refined_innate_score + refined_adaptive_score,
      data = boot_df,
      family = binomial()
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_i)) next

  boot_df$pred_prob_i <- predict(fit_i, type = "response")

  roc_i <- tryCatch(
    roc(
      response = boot_df$group,
      predictor = boot_df$pred_prob_i,
      levels = c("HC", "SCI"),
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(roc_i)) {
    boot_auc[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_i))
  }
}

boot_auc <- boot_auc[!is.na(boot_auc)]

boot_ci <- quantile(
  boot_auc,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(AUC = boot_auc),
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_bootstrap_auc_distribution.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    AUC_observed = auc_real,
    bootstrap_AUC_median = as.numeric(boot_ci[2]),
    bootstrap_AUC_CI_low = as.numeric(boot_ci[1]),
    bootstrap_AUC_CI_high = as.numeric(boot_ci[3]),
    n_boot_valid = length(boot_auc)
  ),
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_bootstrap_auc_CI.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 11. Fig5D: enlarged permutation test
## =========================

n_perm <- 1000
perm_auc <- rep(NA_real_, n_perm)

for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {

  perm_df <- clf_df

  perm_df$outcome_perm <- sample(perm_df$outcome)
  perm_df$group_perm <- factor(
    ifelse(perm_df$outcome_perm == 1, "SCI", "HC"),
    levels = c("HC", "SCI")
  )

  fit_perm <- tryCatch(
    glm(
      outcome_perm ~ refined_innate_score + refined_adaptive_score,
      data = perm_df,
      family = binomial()
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_perm)) next

  perm_df$pred_prob_perm <- predict(fit_perm, type = "response")

  roc_perm <- tryCatch(
    roc(
      response = perm_df$group_perm,
      predictor = perm_df$pred_prob_perm,
      levels = c("HC", "SCI"),
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(roc_perm)) {
    perm_auc[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_perm))
  }
}

perm_auc <- perm_auc[!is.na(perm_auc)]

perm_p <- (sum(perm_auc >= auc_real) + 1) / (length(perm_auc) + 1)

perm_df_out <- data.frame(AUC = perm_auc)

write.csv(
  perm_df_out,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_permutation_auc_distribution.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    observed_AUC = auc_real,
    permutation_p_value = perm_p,
    n_perm_valid = length(perm_auc)
  ),
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_permutation_test_stats.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

pD <- ggplot(perm_df_out, aes(x = AUC)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = auc_real,
    color = "#D73027",
    linewidth = 1.0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Permutation test",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Observed AUC = ",
      round(auc_real, 3),
      "; permutation P = ",
      signif(perm_p, 3)
    ),
    x = "AUC under random label permutation",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_pub(11)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5D_permutation_test_large.pdf"),
  pD,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 12. Optional bootstrap panel
## =========================

p_boot <- ggplot(data.frame(AUC = boot_auc), aes(x = AUC)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "#7B3294",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = auc_real,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = boot_ci[c(1, 3)],
    color = "grey30",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap AUC stability",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Median = ",
      round(boot_ci[2], 3),
      "; 95% CI = ",
      round(boot_ci[1], 3),
      "–",
      round(boot_ci[3], 3)
    ),
    x = "Bootstrap AUC",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_pub(11)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_optional_bootstrap_AUC_CI_large.pdf"),
  p_boot,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 13. Combined enlarged Figure 5 ABCD
## =========================

pABCD <- pA + pB + pC + pD +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 4,
    widths = c(1.2, 1.2, 1, 1.1)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")
    )
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5ABCD_combined_final_large.pdf"),
  pABCD,
  width = 36,
  height = 11,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 14. Summary table
## =========================

summary_out <- data.frame(
  figure = "Figure 5",
  model = "Mechanism-constrained two-feature logistic classifier",
  features = "refined_innate_score + refined_adaptive_score",
  interpretation = "Within-cohort proof-of-concept, not external clinical validation",
  AUC_observed = auc_real,
  bootstrap_AUC_median = as.numeric(boot_ci[2]),
  bootstrap_AUC_CI_low = as.numeric(boot_ci[1]),
  bootstrap_AUC_CI_high = as.numeric(boot_ci[3]),
  permutation_p_value = perm_p,
  n_HC = sum(clf_df$group == "HC"),
  n_SCI = sum(clf_df$group == "SCI"),
  n_total_classifier = nrow(clf_df)
)

write.csv(
  summary_out,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_classifier_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("Done. Enlarged Final Fig5 outputs saved to: ", outdir)
```

```{r fig5 5.26}
## ============================================================
## Final Figure 5 - Immune-state landscape version
##
## Core idea:
## Fig5 is no longer a classifier figure.
## It shows that SCI occupies a distinct low-dimensional
## immune-program state defined by refined innate/adaptive axes.
##
## Panels:
## A: conceptual immune-state landscape schematic
## B: HC/TC/SCI in two-dimensional immune-program space
## C: group-level immune-state shift vectors
## D: permutation test for HC-SCI state-space separation
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(patchwork)
})

set.seed(123)

## =========================
## 0. Paths
## =========================

outdir <- "Final_Figure5_immune_state_landscape"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_expr151 <- "GSE151371_normalized_expression_matrix_ComBat_de-ID.csv"

fig4_dir <- "New_Figure4_ML_refined_modules"
file_module_summary <- file.path(
  fig4_dir,
  "New_Figure4_refined_module_summary.csv"
)

## =========================
## 1. Helper functions
## =========================

read_expr_csv_safe <- function(file) {
  df <- read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  gene_col <- df[[1]]
  df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]

  rownames(df) <- make.unique(as.character(gene_col))
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

  as.matrix(df)
}

clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- sub("^.*>", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  toupper(x)
}

collapse_by_gene <- function(expr) {
  expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
  expr$gene <- clean_gene_symbol(rownames(expr))

  expr <- expr %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene != "NA") %>%
    mutate(mean_expr = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_expr)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-mean_expr)

  mat <- as.matrix(expr[, setdiff(colnames(expr), "gene")])
  rownames(mat) <- expr$gene
  mat
}

z_score_rows <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z
}

module_score <- function(expr_mat, genes, module_name = "module") {
  genes <- clean_gene_symbol(genes)
  genes_found <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))

  message(
    module_name,
    ": ",
    length(genes_found),
    "/",
    length(unique(genes)),
    " genes found: ",
    paste(genes_found, collapse = ", ")
  )

  if (length(genes_found) < 2) {
    stop("Too few genes found for ", module_name)
  }

  z <- z_score_rows(expr_mat[genes_found, , drop = FALSE])
  colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
}

theme_pub <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.45, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.45, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

centroid_distance <- function(df, group1, group2) {
  c1 <- df %>%
    filter(group == group1) %>%
    summarise(
      innate = mean(refined_innate_score),
      adaptive = mean(refined_adaptive_score)
    )

  c2 <- df %>%
    filter(group == group2) %>%
    summarise(
      innate = mean(refined_innate_score),
      adaptive = mean(refined_adaptive_score)
    )

  sqrt((c1$innate - c2$innate)^2 + (c1$adaptive - c2$adaptive)^2)
}

## =========================

module_summary <- read.csv(file_module_summary, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

hc_sci_df <- score_df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("HC", "SCI")) %>%
  mutate(group = droplevels(group))

obs_dist <- centroid_distance(hc_sci_df, "HC", "SCI")

n_perm <- 5000
perm_dist <- rep(NA_real_, n_perm)

for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
  perm_df <- hc_sci_df
  perm_df$group <- sample(perm_df$group)

  perm_dist[i] <- centroid_distance(perm_df, "HC", "SCI")
}

perm_p <- (sum(perm_dist >= obs_dist) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)

)

      "Observed HC-SCI distance = ",
      round(obs_dist, 3),
      "; permutation P = ",
      signif(perm_p, 3)
    ),
    x = "Permuted HC-SCI centroid distance",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_pub(11)

ggsave(
```

```{r fig5 5.26}
## ============================================================
## Final Figure 5 - Simplified immune-state landscape version
##
## Main message:
## SCI induces a coordinated transition toward an
## innate-high / adaptive-low immune state.
##
## Main figure:
## A: immune-program state space
## B: centroid shift from HC to TC/SCI
## C: immune reprogramming index
##
## Supplementary:
## permutation test for HC-SCI centroid separation
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(patchwork)
})

set.seed(123)

## =========================
## 0. Paths
## =========================

outdir <- "Final_Figure5_simplified_immune_state"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_expr151 <- "GSE151371_normalized_expression_matrix_ComBat_de-ID.csv"

fig4_dir <- "New_Figure4_ML_refined_modules"
file_module_summary <- file.path(
  fig4_dir,
  "New_Figure4_refined_module_summary.csv"
)

## =========================
## 1. Helper functions
## =========================

read_expr_csv_safe <- function(file) {
  df <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  gene_col <- df[[1]]
  df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]

  rownames(df) <- make.unique(as.character(gene_col))
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

  as.matrix(df)
}

clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- sub("^.*>", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  toupper(x)
}

collapse_by_gene <- function(expr) {
  expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
  expr$gene <- clean_gene_symbol(rownames(expr))

  expr <- expr %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene != "NA") %>%
    mutate(mean_expr = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_expr)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-mean_expr)

  mat <- as.matrix(expr[, setdiff(colnames(expr), "gene")])
  rownames(mat) <- expr$gene
  mat
}

z_score_rows <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z
}

module_score <- function(expr_mat, genes, module_name = "module") {
  genes <- clean_gene_symbol(genes)
  genes_found <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))

  message(
    module_name,
    ": ",
    length(genes_found),
    "/",
    length(unique(genes)),
    " genes found: ",
    paste(genes_found, collapse = ", ")
  )

  if (length(genes_found) < 2) {
    stop("Too few genes found for ", module_name)
  }

  z <- z_score_rows(expr_mat[genes_found, , drop = FALSE])
  colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
}

centroid_distance <- function(df, group1, group2) {
  c1 <- df %>%
    filter(group == group1) %>%
    summarise(
      innate = mean(refined_innate_score),
      adaptive = mean(refined_adaptive_score)
    )

  c2 <- df %>%
    filter(group == group2) %>%
    summarise(
      innate = mean(refined_innate_score),
      adaptive = mean(refined_adaptive_score)
    )

  sqrt((c1$innate - c2$innate)^2 + (c1$adaptive - c2$adaptive)^2)
}

theme_pub <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.45, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.45, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

## =========================
## 2. Read refined module genes
## =========================

    sd = sd(immune_reprogramming_index),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  index_stats,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_immune_reprogramming_index_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

pC <- ggplot(
  score_df,
  aes(
    x = group,
    y = immune_reprogramming_index,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.55,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(
      c("HC", "TC"),
      c("HC", "SCI"),
      c("TC", "SCI")
    ),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Immune reprogramming index",
    subtitle = "Integrated innate activation and adaptive suppression",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Innate score − adaptive score"
  ) +
  theme_pub(11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5C_immune_reprogramming_index.pdf"),
  pC,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 9. Supplementary permutation test
## =========================

hc_sci_df <- score_df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("HC", "SCI")) %>%
  mutate(group = droplevels(group))

obs_dist <- centroid_distance(hc_sci_df, "HC", "SCI")

n_perm <- 5000
perm_dist <- rep(NA_real_, n_perm)

for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
  perm_df <- hc_sci_df
  perm_df$group <- sample(perm_df$group)

  perm_dist[i] <- centroid_distance(
    perm_df,
    "HC",
    "SCI"
  )
}

perm_p <- (sum(perm_dist >= obs_dist) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)

perm_out <- data.frame(
  permutation_distance = perm_dist
)

write.csv(
  perm_out,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_supp_permutation_centroid_distance.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    observed_HC_SCI_centroid_distance = obs_dist,
    permutation_p_value = perm_p,
    n_perm = n_perm
  ),
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_supp_permutation_stats.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

p_perm <- ggplot(
  perm_out,
  aes(x = permutation_distance)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 40,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = obs_dist,
    color = "#D73027",
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Permutation test for HC-SCI immune-state separation",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Observed distance = ",
      round(obs_dist, 3),
      "; permutation P = ",
      signif(perm_p, 3)
    ),
    x = "Permuted HC-SCI centroid distance",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_pub(11)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_supp_permutation_immune_state_separation.pdf"),
  p_perm,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 10. Combined main Figure 5 ABC
## =========================

pABC <- pA + pB + pC +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 3,
    widths = c(1.25, 1.05, 0.9)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5ABC_simplified_immune_state_main.pdf"),
  pABC,
  width = 34,
  height = 11,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 11. Summary table
## =========================

summary_out <- data.frame(
  figure = "Figure 5",
  concept = "Immune-state landscape",
  main_message = "SCI induces a coordinated transition toward an innate-high/adaptive-low immune state",
  x_axis = "Refined innate module score",
  y_axis = "Refined adaptive module score",
  index = "Refined innate score minus refined adaptive score",
  HC_n = sum(score_df$group == "HC"),
  TC_n = sum(score_df$group == "TC"),
  SCI_n = sum(score_df$group == "SCI"),
  HC_SCI_centroid_distance = obs_dist,
  permutation_p_value = perm_p
)

write.csv(
  summary_out,

)

message("Done. Simplified Fig5 outputs saved to: ", outdir)
```
