```{r fig5 5.27}
## ============================================================
## Final Figure 5 - Immune-state landscape ABCD version
##
## Main message:
## SCI induces a coordinated transition toward an
## innate-high / adaptive-low immune state.
##
## Panels:
## A: immune-program state space, circular points only
## B: centroid shift from HC to TC/SCI
## C: immune reprogramming index
## D: HC-to-SCI immune-state projection / continuum score
##
## Supplementary:
## permutation test for HC-SCI centroid separation
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(patchwork)
})

set.seed(123)

## =========================
## 0. Paths
## =========================

outdir <- "Final_Figure5_immune_state_ABCD"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_expr151 <- "GSE151371_normalized_expression_matrix_ComBat_de-ID.csv"

fig4_dir <- "New_Figure4_ML_refined_modules"
file_module_summary <- file.path(
  fig4_dir,
  "New_Figure4_refined_module_summary.csv"
)

## =========================
## 1. Helper functions
## =========================

read_expr_csv_safe <- function(file) {
  df <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  gene_col <- df[[1]]
  df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]

  rownames(df) <- make.unique(as.character(gene_col))
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

  as.matrix(df)
}

clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- sub("^.*>", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  toupper(x)
}

collapse_by_gene <- function(expr) {
  expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
  expr$gene <- clean_gene_symbol(rownames(expr))

  expr <- expr %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene != "NA") %>%
    mutate(mean_expr = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_expr)) %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-mean_expr)

  mat <- as.matrix(expr[, setdiff(colnames(expr), "gene")])
  rownames(mat) <- expr$gene
  mat
}

z_score_rows <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z
}

module_score <- function(expr_mat, genes, module_name = "module") {
  genes <- clean_gene_symbol(genes)
  genes_found <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))

  message(
    module_name,
    ": ",
    length(genes_found),
    "/",
    length(unique(genes)),
    " genes found: ",
    paste(genes_found, collapse = ", ")
  )

  if (length(genes_found) < 2) {
    stop("Too few genes found for ", module_name)
  }

  z <- z_score_rows(expr_mat[genes_found, , drop = FALSE])
  colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
}

centroid_distance <- function(df, group1, group2) {
  c1 <- df %>%
    filter(group == group1) %>%
    summarise(
      innate = mean(refined_innate_score),
      adaptive = mean(refined_adaptive_score)
    )

  c2 <- df %>%
    filter(group == group2) %>%
    summarise(
      innate = mean(refined_innate_score),
      adaptive = mean(refined_adaptive_score)
    )

  sqrt((c1$innate - c2$innate)^2 + (c1$adaptive - c2$adaptive)^2)
}

theme_pub <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.45, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.45, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

## =========================
## 2. Read refined module genes
## =========================

module_summary <- read.csv(
  file_module_summary,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

refined_innate <- module_summary %>%
  filter(module == "Refined innate") %>%
  pull(genes) %>%
  strsplit(";\\s*") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  clean_gene_symbol()

refined_adaptive <- module_summary %>%
  filter(module == "Refined adaptive") %>%
  pull(genes) %>%
  strsplit(";\\s*") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  clean_gene_symbol()

refined_innate <- refined_innate[refined_innate != ""]
refined_adaptive <- refined_adaptive[refined_adaptive != ""]

message("Refined innate genes: ", paste(refined_innate, collapse = ", "))
message("Refined adaptive genes: ", paste(refined_adaptive, collapse = ", "))

## =========================
## 3. Read GSE151371
## =========================

expr151 <- read_expr_csv_safe(file_expr151)
expr151 <- collapse_by_gene(expr151)

meta151 <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(expr151),
  group = case_when(
    grepl("^HC", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "HC",
    grepl("^TC", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TC",
    grepl("^SCI", colnames(expr151), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "SCI",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

meta151 <- meta151 %>%
  filter(!is.na(group))

expr151 <- expr151[, meta151$sample, drop = FALSE]

meta151$group <- factor(
  meta151$group,
  levels = c("HC", "TC", "SCI")
)

message("Sample size:")
print(table(meta151$group))

## =========================
## 4. Calculate immune-program scores
## =========================

score_df <- meta151 %>%
  mutate(
    refined_innate_score = module_score(
      expr151,
      refined_innate,
      "Refined innate"
    ),
    refined_adaptive_score = module_score(
      expr151,
      refined_adaptive,
      "Refined adaptive"
    ),
    immune_reprogramming_index =
      refined_innate_score - refined_adaptive_score
  )

write.csv(
  score_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_immune_state_scores_GSE151371.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 5. Group centroids and vectors
## =========================

centroid_df <- score_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    centroid_innate = mean(refined_innate_score),
    centroid_adaptive = mean(refined_adaptive_score),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  centroid_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_group_centroids.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

hc_centroid <- centroid_df %>%
  filter(group == "HC")

sci_centroid <- centroid_df %>%
  filter(group == "SCI")

vector_df <- centroid_df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("TC", "SCI")) %>%
  mutate(
    x_start = hc_centroid$centroid_innate,
    y_start = hc_centroid$centroid_adaptive,
    x_end = centroid_innate,
    y_end = centroid_adaptive,
    distance_from_HC = sqrt(
      (x_end - x_start)^2 + (y_end - y_start)^2
    )
  )

write.csv(
  vector_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_state_shift_vectors.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

group_cols <- c(
  "HC" = "#4D4D4D",
  "TC" = "#4575B4",
  "SCI" = "#D73027"
)

## =========================
## 6. Fig5D score:
## HC-to-SCI immune-state projection
## =========================

hc_vec <- c(
  hc_centroid$centroid_innate,
  hc_centroid$centroid_adaptive
)

sci_vec <- c(
  sci_centroid$centroid_innate,
  sci_centroid$centroid_adaptive
)

axis_vec <- sci_vec - hc_vec
axis_len2 <- sum(axis_vec^2)

score_mat <- score_df %>%
  select(refined_innate_score, refined_adaptive_score) %>%
  as.matrix()

projection_raw <- apply(score_mat, 1, function(z) {
  sample_vec <- as.numeric(z)
  sum((sample_vec - hc_vec) * axis_vec) / axis_len2
})

score_df$HC_to_SCI_projection <- projection_raw

## 解释：
## projection = 0 表示接近 HC centroid
## projection = 1 表示接近 SCI centroid
## >1 表示比 SCI centroid 更 SCI-like
## <0 表示比 HC centroid 更远离 SCI direction

write.csv(
  score_df,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_immune_state_scores_with_projection.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

projection_stats <- score_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_projection = median(HC_to_SCI_projection),
    mean_projection = mean(HC_to_SCI_projection),
    sd_projection = sd(HC_to_SCI_projection),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  projection_stats,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5D_HC_to_SCI_projection_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =========================
## 7. Fig5A: immune-program state space
## 只保留圆形点，不显示菱形 centroid
## =========================

pA <- ggplot(
  score_df,
  aes(
    x = refined_innate_score,
    y = refined_adaptive_score,
    color = group,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  stat_ellipse(
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(
    title = "SCI occupies a distinct immune-program state",
    subtitle = "Refined innate and adaptive modules define a low-dimensional immune-state space",
    x = "Refined innate module score",
    y = "Refined adaptive module score",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub(11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5A_immune_state_space_HC_TC_SCI.pdf"),
  pA,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  units = "cm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

## =========================
## 8. Fig5B: centroid shift
## =========================

pB <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = centroid_df,

      x = centroid_innate,

    ),

  ) +

  HC_n = sum(score_df$group == "HC"),
  TC_n = sum(score_df$group == "TC"),
  SCI_n = sum(score_df$group == "SCI"),
  HC_SCI_centroid_distance = obs_dist,
  permutation_p_value = perm_p
)

write.csv(
  summary_out,
  file.path(outdir, "Fig5_immune_state_ABCD_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("Done. Final Fig5 ABCD outputs saved to: ", outdir)
```

```{r 数据归总}
library(openxlsx)

wb <- createWorkbook()

add_sheet_from_csv <- function(wb, sheet_name, file_path) {
  df <- read.csv(
    file_path,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df)
  freezePane(wb, sheet = sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(df), widths = "auto")
}

add_sheet_from_csv(wb, "S1_DEGs",
```
